sub: Vietnam's first national chronicle begins with a Qin officer from the north.

title: TRIỆU VŨ ĐẾ
sub: In 1272, Lê Văn Hưu began it with Zhao Tuo, as Triệu Vũ Đế.

title: A HERO?

title: NGÔ THÌ SĨ

title: AN INVADER?
